/-- Rows `X i`, `Z i` with Gram matrix `X Z(*@\ensuremath{^{\mathsf T}}@*) = 1` are dual bases: `(*@\ensuremath{\Sigma}@*)(*@\ensuremath{_i}@*) x(*@\ensuremath{_i}@*) z(*@\ensuremath{_i}@*)(*@\ensuremath{^{\mathsf T}}@*) = X(*@\ensuremath{^{\mathsf T}}@*) Z = 1`. -/
theorem gram_one_iff_sum_outer {n : (*@\ensuremath{\mathbb N}@*)} (X Z : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) K) :
    X * Z(*@\ensuremath{^{\mathsf T}}@*) = 1 (*@\ensuremath{\leftrightarrow}@*) X(*@\ensuremath{^{\mathsf T}}@*) * Z = 1 := by
  constructor
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro h
    have h2 : Z(*@\ensuremath{^{\mathsf T}}@*) * X = 1 := mul_eq_one_comm.mp h
    simpa [Matrix.transpose_mul] using congrArg Matrix.transpose h2
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro h
    have h2 : Z(*@\ensuremath{^{\mathsf T}}@*) * X = 1 := by simpa [Matrix.transpose_mul] using congrArg Matrix.transpose h
    exact mul_eq_one_comm.mp h2

/-- Lemma (branching), sibling exclusion: if the children `L 0, (*@\ensuremath{\ldots}@*), L (r-1)` are tried in order
and the `u`-th subtree excludes the earlier children, a completion `A` that contains some child is
visited in exactly one subtree, namely that of the first child it contains. -/
theorem first_member_unique {(*@\ensuremath{\alpha}@*) : Type*} {r : (*@\ensuremath{\mathbb N}@*)} (L : Fin r (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\alpha}@*)) (A : Set (*@\ensuremath{\alpha}@*))
    (h : (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) u, L u (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) A) : (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*)! u, L u (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) A (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) v, v < u (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) L v (*@\ensuremath{\notin}@*) A := by
  classical
  let P : (*@\ensuremath{\mathbb N}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Prop := fun t => (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) hu : t < r, L (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)t, hu(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) A
  have hex : (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) t, P t := by obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)u, hu(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := h; exact (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)u, u.2, hu(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  let t := Nat.find hex
  obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)ht, hA(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Nat.find_spec hex
  refine (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)(*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)t, ht(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*), (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)hA, ?_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*), ?_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro v hv hvA
    exact Nat.find_min hex (show v.1 < t from hv) (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)v.2, hvA(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) rintro w (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)hwA, hwmin(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
    apply Fin.ext
    apply le_antisymm
    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) by_contra hlt

    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) exact Nat.find_min' hex (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)w.2, hwA(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)

/-- An induced matching of size `m` (an `m (*@\ensuremath{\times}@*) m` identity submatrix of `G`) has `m (*@\ensuremath{\le}@*) rank G`. -/
theorem induced_matching_le_rank {m p q : (*@\ensuremath{\mathbb N}@*)} (G : Matrix (Fin p) (Fin q) K)
    (S : Fin m (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Fin p) (T : Fin m (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Fin q) (h : G.submatrix S T = 1) : m (*@\ensuremath{\le}@*) G.rank := by
  let Rs : Matrix (Fin m) (Fin p) K := Matrix.of fun a i => if S a = i then 1 else 0
  let Ct : Matrix (Fin q) (Fin m) K := Matrix.of fun j b => if T b = j then 1 else 0
  have hsub : Rs * G * Ct = G.submatrix S T := by
    ext a b
    simp only [Rs, Ct, Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.of_apply, Matrix.submatrix_apply, ite_mul, one_mul,
      zero_mul, mul_ite, mul_one, mul_zero, Finset.sum_ite_eq, Finset.mem_univ, ite_true]
  have h1 : (Rs * G * Ct).rank (*@\ensuremath{\le}@*) G.rank :=
    (Matrix.rank_mul_le_left _ _).trans (Matrix.rank_mul_le_right _ _)
  rw [hsub, h, Matrix.rank_one, Fintype.card_fin] at h1
  exact h1
\end{lstlisting}

/-- **Certificate theorem.** Suppose `g i` (with inverses `ginv i`) are automorphisms, `K` rounds
of refinement put `v0` in a class consisting of images of `v0` under the `g i`, and after
individualising `v0`, `M` more rounds give every vertex its own index as colour. Then every
automorphism is one of the `g i`. -/
theorem aut_of_certificate {(*@\ensuremath{\iota}@*) : Type} (g ginv : (*@\ensuremath{\iota}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Fin n (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Fin n)
    (hgi : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) i u, g i (ginv i u) = u) (hig : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) i u, ginv i (g i u) = u)
    (hgaut : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) i u w, G (g i u) (g i w) = G u w) (K M : (*@\ensuremath{\mathbb N}@*)) (v0 : Fin n)
    (hclass : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u, col ((refineA G)^[K] (zeros n)) u = col ((refineA G)^[K] (zeros n)) v0 (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
      (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) i, g i v0 = u)
    (hdisc : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u : Fin n, col ((refineA G)^[M] (indiv ((refineA G)^[K] (zeros n)) v0)) u = u.1)
    ((*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) : Equiv.Perm (Fin n)) (h(*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u w, G ((*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) u) ((*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) w) = G u w) :
    (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) i, (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u, (*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) u = g i u := by
  have hK : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) : Equiv.Perm (Fin n), ((*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u w, G ((*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) u) ((*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) w) = G u w) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
      (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) v, col ((refineA G)^[K] (zeros n)) ((*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) v) = col ((refineA G)^[K] (zeros n)) v :=
    fun (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) v => col_iter_equiv (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) K _ (fun v => by rw [col_zeros, col_zeros]) v
  obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)i, hi(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := hclass ((*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) v0) (hK (*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) h(*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) v0)
  -- `(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) = (g i)(*@\ensuremath{^{-}}@*)(*@\ensuremath{^{1}}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\circ}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*)` is an automorphism fixing `v0`.
  let (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) : Equiv.Perm (Fin n) := (*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*).trans (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)ginv i, g i, fun u => hgi i u, fun u => hig i u(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  have hginv : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u w, G (ginv i u) (ginv i w) = G u w := fun u w => by
    rw [(*@\ensuremath{\leftarrow}@*) hgaut i, hgi, hgi]
  have h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u w, G ((*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) u) ((*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) w) = G u w := fun u w => by
    simp only [(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*), Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, hginv, h(*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*)]
  have h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*)0 : (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) v0 = v0 := by simp only [(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*), Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_mk, (*@\ensuremath{\leftarrow}@*) hi, hig]
  have hd0 : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) v, col (indiv ((refineA G)^[K] (zeros n)) v0) ((*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) v) =
      col (indiv ((refineA G)^[K] (zeros n)) v0) v := fun v => by
    rw [col_indiv, col_indiv, hK (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) v]
    have : (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) v = v0 (*@\ensuremath{\leftrightarrow}@*) v = v0 := (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)fun h => (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*).injective (h.trans h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*)0.symm), fun h => h (*@\ensuremath{\triangleright}@*) h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*)0(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
    simp only [this]
  have hid : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u, (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) u = u := fun u => by
    have := col_iter_equiv (*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) h(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*) M _ hd0 u
    rw [hdisc, hdisc] at this
    exact Fin.ext this
  refine (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)i, fun u => ?_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  have h := hid u
  simp only [(*@\ensuremath{\psi}@*), Equiv.trans_apply, Equiv.coe_fn_mk] at h

/-- **Theorem `thm:aut`.** Every automorphism of the anticommutation graph (a permutation of the
1440 vertices preserving adjacency, possibly exchanging the two sides) is one of the 32 maps
`gmap b k = T^k (*@\ensuremath{\circ}@*) s^b`. Together with `gmap_aut` and `gmap_distinct`, the automorphism group has
exactly 32 elements. -/
theorem aut_classification ((*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) : Equiv.Perm V) (h(*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u w, adj ((*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) u) ((*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) w) = adj u w) :
    (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) b : Bool, (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) k : Fin 16, (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) u, (*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) u = gmap b k u := by
  obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)i, hi(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := aut_of_certificate adj (fun i : Bool (*@\ensuremath{\times}@*) Fin 16 => gmap i.1 i.2)
    (fun i => ginv i.1 i.2) (fun i u => gmap_ginv i.1 i.2 u) (fun i u => ginv_gmap i.1 i.2 u)
    (fun i u w => gmap_aut i.1 i.2 u w) 3 4 0 class_v0 dM_id (*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*) h(*@\ensuremath{\varphi}@*)
  exact (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)i.1, i.2, hi(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)

/-- Semantic obligations for a concrete implementation. These are hypotheses,
not axioms. In particular `branch_cover` must establish residual coverage and
`next_sound` must establish disjointness, orthogonality and residual updates. -/
structure RulesSound {State Item Entry Frame : Type}
    (rules : Rules State Item Entry) (Completes : State (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Frame (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Prop)
    (Contains : Frame (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Item (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Prop) : Prop where
  rank_sound : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) s f, Completes s f (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) rules.rankOk s = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) False
  empty_sound : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) s f e, Completes s f (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) rules.emptyOk s e = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) False
  branch_cover : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) s f e qs, Completes s f (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) rules.branchOk s e qs = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
    (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) q, q (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) qs (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) Contains f q
  large_sound : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) s f q, Completes s f (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Contains f q (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) rules.eligible s q = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
    rules.tooLarge s q = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) False
  next_sound : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) s f done q, Completes s f (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Contains f q (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) rules.eligible s q = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
    ((*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) r, r (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) done (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) Contains f r) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) f', Completes (rules.next s done q) f'
\end{lstlisting}

\begin{lstlisting}
private theorem checkChildren_sound {State Item Entry Frame : Type}
    (rules : Rules State Item Entry) (Completes : State (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Frame (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Prop)
    (Contains : Frame (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Item (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Prop) (sound : RulesSound rules Completes Contains)
    (run : State (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Tree Item Entry (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Bool)
    (run_sound : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) s t f, run s t = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Completes s f (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) False)
    (s : State) (f : Frame) (hf : Completes s f) :
    (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) (children : List (Item (*@\ensuremath{\times}@*) Option (Tree Item Entry))) (done : List Item),
      ((*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) r, r (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) done (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) Contains f r) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
      checkChildren rules run s done children = true (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
      ((*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) q, q (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) children.map Prod.fst (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) Contains f q) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) False := by
  intro children
  induction children with
  | nil =>
      intro done hd hc hex
      simp at hex
  | cons head rest ih =>
      rcases head with (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)q, child(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
      intro done hd hc hex
      have eligibleAndChecks := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp hc
      have he := eligibleAndChecks.1
      have checks := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp eligibleAndChecks.2
      by_cases hq : Contains f q
      (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) cases child with
        | none => exact sound.large_sound s f q hf hq he checks.1
        | some t =>
            obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)f', hf'(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := sound.next_sound s f done q hf hq he hd
            exact run_sound (rules.next s done q) t f' checks.1 hf'
      (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) apply ih (done ++ [q])
        (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro r hr
          rcases List.mem_append.mp hr with hr | hr
          (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) exact hd r hr
          (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) have heq : r = q := List.mem_singleton.mp hr
            simpa [heq] using hq
        (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) exact checks.2
        (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) rcases hex with (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)r, hr, hrf(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
          refine (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)r, ?_, hrf(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
          have hm : r = q (*@\ensuremath{\vee}@*) r (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) rest.map Prod.fst := by simpa using hr
          rcases hm with heq | hm
          (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) exact False.elim (hq (heq (*@\ensuremath{\triangleright}@*) hrf))
          (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) exact hm

\begin{lstlisting}
/-- Acceptance excludes every semantic completion, for arbitrary fuel and data.
Instantiating this theorem requires a proof of every `RulesSound` field. -/
theorem check_sound {State Item Entry Frame : Type}
    (rules : Rules State Item Entry) (Completes : State (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Frame (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Prop)
    (Contains : Frame (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Item (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Prop) (sound : RulesSound rules Completes Contains)
    (fuel : Nat) (s : State) (t : Tree Item Entry) (f : Frame)
    (accepted : check rules fuel s t = true) : (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) Completes s f := by
  induction fuel generalizing s t f with
  | zero => simp [check] at accepted
  | succ fuel ih =>
      intro hf
      simp only [check] at accepted
      split at accepted
      (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) contradiction
      (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) cases t with
        | rank => exact sound.rank_sound s f hf accepted
        | empty e => exact sound.empty_sound s f e hf accepted
        | shard => contradiction
        | frame => contradiction
        | branch e children =>
            have checks := Bool.and_eq_true_iff.mp accepted
            exact checkChildren_sound rules Completes Contains sound (check rules fuel)
              (fun s t f hc hf => ih s t f hc hf) s f hf children []
              (by simp) checks.2 (sound.branch_cover s f e _ hf checks.1)
\end{lstlisting}
\subsection*{Certificate soundness: the concrete frame semantics (\texttt{CertGPTCompletion.lean})}
\noindent\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTCompletion.lean\#L14}{\texttt{Completion}}~(\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/5f6872bd0f441c466ccc01260ebf784599b08b56/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTCompletion.lean\#L14}{pinned}), line 14.
\begin{lstlisting}
/-- Concrete mathematical completion invariant. The witness is the *remaining*
item list, so choosing q passes `qs.erase q` to the child. -/
structure Completion (d : Instance) (s : SearchState) (qs : List Nat) : Prop where
  idsNodup : qs.Nodup
  live : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) q (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) qs, q (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) s.live
  itemBound : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) q (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) qs, q < d.items.size
  pairBounds : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) p (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) pairsOf d qs, p.1 < d.x.size (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) p.2 < d.z.size
  pairsNodup : (pairsOf d qs).Nodup
  frame : IsPairFrame (gramField d) (pairsOf d qs).toFinset
  disjoint : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) q (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) qs, (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) r (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) qs, q (*@\ensuremath{\ne}@*) r (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) Disjoint (pairSet d.items[q]!) (pairSet d.items[r]!)
  count : pairCount d qs = s.need
  residual : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) c, c < 128 (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) k, k < 128 (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*)
    bit s.residual[c]! k = paritySum (fun q => cov d q c k) qs
\end{lstlisting}
\noindent\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTCompletion.lean\#L97}{\texttt{completionRulesSound}}~(\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/5f6872bd0f441c466ccc01260ebf784599b08b56/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTCompletion.lean\#L97}{pinned}), line 97.
\begin{lstlisting}
/-- All semantic obligations for the actual executable operations are proved.
No frame-exclusion assumption or certificate acceptance is used here. -/
theorem completionRulesSound (d : Instance) :
    RulesSound (concreteRules d) (Completion d) (fun qs q => q (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) qs) := by
  constructor
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro s qs h hcheck
    apply rankLeaf_contradiction d s (pairsOf d qs).toFinset h.frame
    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) rw [List.toFinset_card_of_nodup h.pairsNodup, pairsOf_length, h.count]
    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro p hp
      obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)q,hq,hp(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := List.mem_flatMap.mp (List.mem_toFinset.mp hp)
      exact (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)q,h.live q hq,Array.mem_toList_iff.mp hp(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) exact hcheck
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro s qs e h hcheck
    have hc := hcheck
    simp only [concreteRules, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)(*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)(*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)hc,hk(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*),_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*),_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := hc
    exact concrete_empty_contradiction d s e.1 e.2 qs h.live
      (h.residual e.1 hc e.2 hk) hcheck
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro s qs e children h hcheck
    have hc := hcheck
    simp only [concreteRules, Bool.and_eq_true, decide_eq_true_eq] at hc
    obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)(*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)(*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)hc,hk(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*),_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*),_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := hc
    exact concrete_branch_covers_remaining d s e.1 e.2 qs children h.live
      (h.residual e.1 hc e.2 hk) hcheck
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro s qs q h hq _ hlarge
    exact concrete_large_contradiction d s qs q hq h.count hlarge
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro s qs done q h hq _ hdone
    exact (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)qs.erase q, h.next q hq done hdone(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
\end{lstlisting}
\subsection*{From a swap-invariant frame to a root completion (\texttt{CertGPTRoot.lean})}
\noindent\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTRoot.lean\#L75}{\texttt{frame\_root\_completion}}~(\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/5f6872bd0f441c466ccc01260ebf784599b08b56/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTRoot.lean\#L75}{pinned}), line 75.
\begin{lstlisting}
 theorem frame_root_completion (d : Instance) (F : Finset Pair)
    (hv : validateItems d "swap" = true)
    (hf : IsPairFrame (gramField d) F) (hs : F.image Prod.swap = F)
    (hb : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) p (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) F, p.1 < d.x.size (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) p.2 < d.z.size)
    (hc : F.card = 128) : (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) qs, Completion d (rootState d) qs := by
  obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)qs, hid, hi, hn, he, hd(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := validated_frame_table_list d F hv hf hs hb
  have hcount : pairCount d qs = 128 := by
    rw [(*@\ensuremath{\leftarrow}@*) pairsOf_length]
    have hh := List.toFinset_card_of_nodup hn
    rw [he, hc] at hh
    exact hh.symm
  have hfdot : IsPairFrame
      (fun i j => (*@\ensuremath{\sum}@*) c : Fin 128, toVec d.x[i]! c * toVec d.z[j]! c) F := by
    have hg : (fun i j => (*@\ensuremath{\sum}@*) c : Fin 128, toVec d.x[i]! c * toVec d.z[j]! c) = gramField d := by
      funext i j
      change (toVec d.x[i]! (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*)(*@\ensuremath{_v}@*) toVec d.z[j]!) = bitZ (par128 (d.x[i]! &&& d.z[j]!))
      rw [par128_eq_bitParity]
      exact dot_eq_bitZ _ _
    rw [hg]
    exact hf
  have houter := pairFrame_identity (fun i => toVec d.x[i]!) (fun j => toVec d.z[j]!) F hc hfdot
  refine (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)qs, (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)hid, ?_, hi, ?_, hn, ?_, hd, hcount, ?_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro q hq
    exact Array.mem_range.mpr (hi q hq)
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro p hp
    apply hb p
    rw [(*@\ensuremath{\leftarrow}@*) he]
    exact List.mem_toFinset.mpr hp
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) simpa only [pairsOf, he] using hf
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) apply root_residual_of_identity d qs hn
    simpa only [he] using houter
\end{lstlisting}
\noindent\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTRoot.lean\#L109}{\texttt{no\_swap\_frame\_of\_check}}~(\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/5f6872bd0f441c466ccc01260ebf784599b08b56/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTRoot.lean\#L109}{pinned}), line 109.
\begin{lstlisting}
/-- Unconditional semantic soundness for bounded swap-invariant pair frames.
Both hypotheses are executable checks, not assumptions of mathematical completeness. -/
theorem no_swap_frame_of_check (d : Instance) (tokens : Array Nat)
    (itemsOK : validateItems d "swap" = true) (accepted : checkViaKernel d tokens = true) :
    (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) F : Finset Pair,
      IsPairFrame (gramField d) F (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) F.card = 128 (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) F.image Prod.swap = F (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*)
      ((*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) p (*@\ensuremath{\in}@*) F, p.1 < d.x.size (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) p.2 < d.z.size) := by
  rintro (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)F, hf, hc, hs, hb(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  exact checkViaKernel_no_completion d tokens accepted
    (frame_root_completion d F itemsOK hf hs hb hc)
\end{lstlisting}
\subsection*{The concrete theorem for the swap class (\texttt{CertGPTNoSwap.lean})}
\noindent\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTNoSwap.lean\#L22}{\texttt{no\_finite\_swap\_frame\_of\_check}}~(\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/5f6872bd0f441c466ccc01260ebf784599b08b56/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTNoSwap.lean\#L22}{pinned}), line 22.
\begin{lstlisting}
theorem no_finite_swap_frame_of_check {N : Nat} (d : Instance) (tokens : Array Nat)
    (hx : d.x.size = N) (hz : d.z.size = N)
    (hv : validateItems d "swap" = true) (ha : checkViaKernel d tokens = true) :
    (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) F : Finset (Fin N (*@\ensuremath{\times}@*) Fin N), IsPairFrame (arrayG d.x d.z) F (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*)
      F.card = 128 (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) F.image Prod.swap = F := by
  classical
  rintro (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)F,hf,hc,hs(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  apply no_swap_frame_of_check d tokens hv ha
  refine (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)F.image natPair, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) refine (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)?_,?_,?_(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro p hp q hq he
      obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)a,ha,rfl(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)b,hb,rfl(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      exact congrArg natPair (hf.1 a ha b hb (Fin.ext he))
    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro p hp q hq he
      obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)a,ha,rfl(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)b,hb,rfl(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      exact congrArg natPair (hf.2.1 a ha b hb (Fin.ext he))
    (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro p hp q hq
      obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)a,ha,rfl(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
      obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)b,hb,rfl(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Finset.mem_image.mp hq
      have hh := hf.2.2 a ha b hb
      change arrayG d.x d.z a.1 b.2 = _
      rw [hh]
      simp only [natPair_injective.eq_iff]
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) rw [Finset.card_image_of_injective _ natPair_injective, hc]
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) calc
      (F.image natPair).image Prod.swap = (F.image Prod.swap).image natPair := by
        simp only [Finset.image_image]
        rfl
      _ = F.image natPair := by rw [hs]
  (*@\ensuremath{\cdot}@*) intro p hp
    obtain (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)a,ha,rfl(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*) := Finset.mem_image.mp hp
    exact (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)hx (*@\ensuremath{\triangleright}@*) a.1.isLt, hz (*@\ensuremath{\triangleright}@*) a.2.isLt(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
\end{lstlisting}
\noindent\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTNoSwap.lean\#L92}{\texttt{no\_swap\_frame}}~(\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/5f6872bd0f441c466ccc01260ebf784599b08b56/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTNoSwap.lean\#L92}{pinned}), line 92.

/-- No size-128 swap-invariant frame exists in the actual 720(*@\ensuremath{\times}@*)720 pool Gram matrix.
The two native_decide facts certify checking and exact equality with PoolData.
All search soundness and frame/orbit mathematics are kernel-proved. -/
theorem no_swap_frame :
    (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) F : Finset (Fin 720 (*@\ensuremath{\times}@*) Fin 720),
      IsPairFrame (arrayG C16Frames.Pools.xArr C16Frames.Pools.zArr) F (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*)
      F.card = 128 (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) F.image Prod.swap = F := by
  exact no_swap_from_decoded C16Frames.Pools.xArr C16Frames.Pools.zArr
    (decodeText swapEncoded) (by decide) (by decide) swap_check_ok swap_pools_ok
\end{lstlisting}

\noindent\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/master/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTVertex.lean\#L88}{\texttt{no\_swap\_vertex\_frame\_of\_no\_pair}}~(\href{https://github.com/alectionary/vibe-math/blob/5f6872bd0f441c466ccc01260ebf784599b08b56/formalization/canonical-width/c16/lean/CertGPTVertex.lean\#L88}{pinned}), line 88.

/-- Any no-swap-pair-frame result transfers to the paper's `(S,T)` formulation. -/
theorem no_swap_vertex_frame_of_no_pair {G : (*@\ensuremath{\iota}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\iota}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\to}@*) ZMod 2} {n : Nat}
    (hG : (*@\ensuremath{\forall}@*) i j, G i j = G j i)
    (hno : (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) F : Finset ((*@\ensuremath{\iota}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\times}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\iota}@*)), IsPairFrame G F (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) F.card = n (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) F.image Prod.swap = F) :
    (*@\ensuremath{\neg}@*) (*@\ensuremath{\exists}@*) S T : Finset (*@\ensuremath{\iota}@*), C16Frames.IsFrame G S T n (*@\ensuremath{\wedge}@*) (T,S) = (S,T) := by
  rintro (*@\ensuremath{\langle}@*)S,T,h,hfixed(*@\ensuremath{\rangle}@*)
  exact hno (swap_fixed_isFrame_pairFrame hG h hfixed)
